import nki
import nki.isa as nisa
import nki.language as nl

@nki.jit
def nki_l2norm_(x):
    R, C = x.shape
    out = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)
    tile = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    
    # Compute sum of squares per row
    s = nl.sum(tile, axis=[1], keepdims=True)
    s += 1e-6
    s = nl.sqrt(s)
    
    # Compute reciprocal of sqrt(sum)
    m = nl.ndarray((R, 1), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=m, data=s, op0=nl.reciprocal, operand0=0.0)
    
    # Multiply tile by reciprocal
    tile = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.sbuf)
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=tile, src=x)
    nisa.tensor_tensor(dst=tile, data1=tile, data2=m, op=nl.multiply)
    
    # Copy result to output
    nisa.dma_copy(dst=out, src=tile)
    return out
